gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules count sale of surplus property inside 'Local' receipts, while the fund statement (p4) and the General Fund combining statement (p5) print it under Other Financing Sources as 'Sale of surplus' (General 11,833 + Road 41,132 = 52,965; the JSON records it as other_financing 52,965). General Fund budget schedule p10: Local actual 379,383 = p5 General Fund sub-column Local 367,550 + Sale of surplus 11,833. Road Fund budget schedule p11: Local actual 95,932 = p4 Road Fund Local 54,800 + Sale of surplus 41,132. Schedule 6,835,210 - statement 6,782,245 = 52,965 = 11,833 + 41,132. Both printed totals are correct as printed (p10 Total Receipts 4,537,830; p11 Total Receipts 1,118,610); no detail line is wrong or missing.
